description: Convert illuminance between lux, foot-candles, phot and nox. Enter a value once and see it in every unit instantly.

faqs.a: One lux is one lumen per square meter — the SI unit of illuminance. A bright office is about 500 lux; direct sunlight is around 100,000 lux.
One lumen per square foot, used mainly in the US lighting industry. 1 foot-candle = 10.7639 lux.
The phot (1 lm/cm² = 10,000 lux) is a CGS unit; the nox (0.001 lux) is used for very low light levels such as moonlight.
